name: Nariyuki Romance
source:
Hero likes watching B movies. But the girlfriend who accompanies him does not mind. It's the spirit of inexperienced youths romance that this story conveys to you.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角喜欢看B级电影，陪他一起看的女友对此毫不介意。这是一个向你传达青涩年轻人恋爱心情的故事。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-october-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]）
